closureBoundary.nodeLifecycle: IPC messages arrive on spawned.on('message'); Node closes the IPC channel before 'close' fires, so 'close' is the last moment an identity message can arrive
closureBoundary.chosenBoundary: the Work Delegation boundary returning from worker.run() — the SHIPPED port resolves that promise only from a close/exit/timeout/abort/error handler, i.e. after it stopped waiting on the child
explicitlyNotClaimed: that a Worker Result line means IPC delivery is complete
that a timeout means all earlier messages arrived

separatedFacts: the identity observation was durably committed
the Invocation's observation window reached a known terminal boundary
the complete observed candidate set was evaluated

observed.candidateCountSource: the durable store, not an in-memory map

remainingUncertainty: a Parent crash before the durable write loses that observation; the guarantee is only that a COMMITTED observation is recoverable (§8.4)
